children: Gold declines in early Asian trade. Expectations of tighter monetary policy across major economies are supporting bond yields, says Infinox's Thadeu Dos Santos in a note. U.S. inflation is still above the Federal Reserve's 2% target and markets continue to price in a December interest rate hike and further tightening beyond the year-end, keeping yields supported and weighing on gold, he says. A firm dollar adds to the pressure, while stronger-than-expected U.S. data sustains the case for keeping monetary conditions restrictive, he adds. A higher interest-rate environment typically weighs on the non-yielding gold. Spot gold is down 0.3% at $4,008.64 an ounce. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
